player_prompt.intro:
Ngwe wena Mdlali {player_id} emdlalweni we HighSociety (imbali yababili).
Mgogodla:  Tiketi letishumi te prestige tiyauctionwa inye emuva kwanye.
Kukhokha:    Mdlalo wumunye, khetha khasoste ikhadi yemali 1-11 bese uyibonise.
            • Inkhokho ephakeme iyawina tiketi ye prestige bese iyisusa ikhadi leyo yemali.
            • Inkhokho ephansi iyabamba ikhadi yayo yemali.
            • Tie -> zombili zikhokho ziyabuyiselwa bese tiketi leyo ye prestige iyauktionwa futhi.
Kuhlunga:    Emva kwetishumi te auction, ongeza **imali esesalayo + amapoyinti e prestige**.
            Inet-worth ephakeme iyawina (tie efanako -> draw).

**Isintakisi sesenzo**  →  khokha ikhadi inye njenge '[7]' noma '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kumele kufake ekhatsi likhadi linye [X] lemali.

message.tie: Igama - imitelo iyabuyiswa. Phinda uyenze imitelo!
message.auction_result: P0 ikhokhe {bid0}, P1 ikhokhe {bid1}. Mdlali {winner} uyawina prestige {prize} (jumla {total}).
